intro: BabelVoice carries sound between you and your meeting app: what you say is translated and sent into the meeting through a virtual microphone, and what's said in the meeting is translated into subtitles for you. When both routes say Ready, you're set.

speak.title: You speak → they hear the translation

driver.label: BabelVoice virtual microphone

description.checking: macOS doesn't let apps pass sound to each other directly; your meeting app hears your translation through this.
description.missing: macOS doesn't let apps pass sound to each other directly. Install it so your meeting app can use it as a microphone and hear your translation.
description.installing: The installer is open. Follow its steps (it asks for this Mac's login password).
description.not-loaded: The driver is installed but macOS hasn't loaded it yet. Restart your Mac.
description.ready: Your meeting app can pick it as its microphone.

driver.installFailedSimple: Couldn't open the installer. Try again.

micPermission.label: Microphone access
micPermission.needed: BabelVoice can't use the microphone yet, so it can't hear you.
micPermission.denied: Microphone access was denied. Turn on BabelVoice in System Settings › Privacy & Security › Microphone, then reopen BabelVoice.

mic.label: Microphone
mic.description: What you say is picked up here.
mic.missing: The selected microphone isn't connected. Pick another one or plug it in.

meetingApp.label: Choose BabelVoice in your meeting app
meetingApp.description: In the audio settings of Zoom, Tencent Meeting, Teams and others, set the microphone to BabelVoice so others hear your translation.

speak.verify: To check they can hear you: test the microphone in your meeting app, start translating and say something — the level meter should move. Your translation only goes into the meeting; you won't hear it on this Mac.

listen.title: They speak → you see subtitles

permission.label: Screen & System Audio Recording
permission.needed: macOS puts listening to other apps under this permission. Without it, BabelVoice can't hear the meeting.
permission.granted: BabelVoice uses it to listen to your meeting app.
permission.restartHint: After allowing it in System Settings, quit and reopen BabelVoice for it to take effect.

output.label: Play translation on
output.description: The translation of what others say plays here.
output.unused: Used once “{{setting}}” is on in Meeting; for now you only get subtitles.
output.defaultIsVirtual: Your system output is BabelVoice, so the translation would go into the meeting. Pick headphones or speakers.

listen.footnote: Which app to listen to, and whether to play the translation, is set on the Meeting page.

virtualDeviceHintMac: BabelVoice (click Install to set up the driver, then set BabelVoice as the mic in your meeting app)
screenCaptureResetHint: No popup? The request may have been denied earlier. Run `tccutil reset ScreenCapture {{bundleId}}` in a terminal and relaunch, or grant it manually in System Settings.
